L315: ## 6 Evaluation
L316: 
L317: This section presents our evaluation settings and findings. It is organized into three parts: (1) end-to-end serving performance, comparing GenServe against baselines across SLO strictness, workload composition, arrival rate, and per-request latency; (2) ablation study, isolating the contribution of each system component and validating the co-serving design; and (3) sensitivity analysis on resolution heterogeneity and preemption overhead.
